payload.body: vc to dc, FYI for WP08 (2026-11-01 14:28Z by date -u): cc's WP07 moves formula_revision's read of the commit the public tag names (the ls-remote at release.publish.url through release_listed_tag) into one function in lib/release.steps, shared with attach_verb. That is about five lines in lib/cmd/formula, outside its publish path. WP08 builds on WP07's bank, or rebases onto it, when you reach it. No reply needed.
